clue.text: Flier in a flap, not knowing the words to sing?

definitions.text: Flier in a flap, not knowing the words to sing?

parts.words: Flier in a flap, not knowing the words to sing?
parts.note: a small ... whose wings beat in a constant blur, described as a singer who has forgotten the lyrics and so just carries the tune with closed lips

explanation.surface: A flustered person on a flight has forgotten the lyrics of a song.
explanation.definitionFit: This tiny American bird is named for the buzzing its rapidly beating wings make, like a tune sung without words.

clue.text: The plea made for a feature of flamenco dancing

indicators.note: the letters are made into something new, so they are reworked into another arrangement

explanation.surface: A request is put forward on behalf of a part of Spanish dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' signals the anagram of THE PLEA. A heeltap is properly a layer of leather in a shoe heel; the clue reads it as the tapping of heels that marks flamenco.
explanation.definitionFit: Flamenco dancers drum their heels on the floor, so a rap of the heel is one of the dance's hallmarks.

clue.text: Handy little stores of information

parts.note: the reading is of small convenient machines that hold and process data, not of shops or pocket notebooks

explanation.definitionFit: Small desktop or portable computers hold large amounts of data in a compact, convenient box.

clue.text: Doctrines contained in one's writing

parts.note: one is I, and with the 's for 'is' it gives I followed by S
MS is the abbreviation for manuscript, a piece of writing

explanation.surface: Beliefs are set out in somebody's written work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one's' is read letter by letter: the Roman numeral for one, then the 's taken as 'is' shortened.
explanation.definitionFit: Words ending in -ism name creeds and schools of thought, and that suffix used alone means any such belief.

clue.text: Stick around a Greek island for a source of energy

indicators.note: the adhesive is wrapped around the island, so one word is placed inside the other

parts.note: glue is something that sticks
Cos (or Kos) is an island in the Dodecanese

explanation.surface: Adhesive wrapped round a piece of Greek territory provides fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: This simple sugar is the main fuel the body burns for energy.

clue.text: See 1
Girl game at thestart

parts.note: bridge is a card game

indicators.note: at the start points to the first letter of the word the

explanation.surface: A girl joins a game right at the outset.
explanation.definitionFit: A common female first name, here standing for any girl.

clue.text: Bring up at thestern

definitions.meaning: the back part of a ship, or the back of anything

explanation.definitionFit: Raising a family is one sense; the hind part, as of a boat, is the other.

clue.text: Happy in substance

definitions.meaning: the matter or meaning contained in something

explanation.definitionFit: Satisfied is one sense (stress on the second syllable); what a thing holds or says is the other (stress on the first).

clue.text: It's a proper map I find put to a wrong use

definitions.text: It's a proper map I find put to a wrong use

indicators.note: letters put to a wrong use are rearranged, so these words signal the anagram as well as defining

explanation.surface: Someone uses a perfectly good map for the wrong purpose.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of IT'S A PROPER MAP I, rearranged, give the answer, and the whole clue describes the misuse of the map.
explanation.definitionFit: To use money or goods for an improper purpose, especially dishonestly, is the dictionary sense.

clue.text: It gives cut in income, leaving Max nothing but put out

definitions.text: It gives cut in income, leaving Max nothing but put out

indicators.note: letters put out of their places are displaced, so this phrase signals the anagram

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A pay cut leaves poor Max penniless and upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put out' rearranges CUT IN INCOME with MAX and O (nothing). Being expelled from a church community is to be 'put out' of it, which the whole clue describes.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal expulsion from the Church's sacraments and fellowship is the meaning.

clue.text: Understood to be all right

parts.note: taken as written
OK means all right

explanation.surface: Something was grasped and agreed to be fine.
explanation.definitionFit: To take a point is to understand it, so the past tense means grasped.

clue.text: Ought to be tenacious; and is

indicators.note: the word ought is turned into what it is to become, a rearrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: A person should be stubborn, and is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be' signals that OUGHT turns into a new word; 'and is' adds that the word so made is the tenacious one.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard to break or deter: resilient and stubborn in holding on.

clue.text: Tea served at the end of a chess game?

definitions.meaning: a South American infusion of holly leaves, drunk from a gourd

definitions.text: the end of a chess game
definitions.meaning: the final blow when the king cannot escape check

explanation.surface: A cuppa is brought out once the chess match is over.
explanation.definitionFit: Yerba maté is the Argentine infusion; checkmate, shortened, ends a chess game.

clue.text: Expensive guest accommodation in silhouette form

indicators.note: the letters are given a new form, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Costly rooms for visitors appear in outline shape.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of connected rooms in an inn is the priciest lodging it offers.

clue.text: See 13
Suggest writing about an Italian flower

indicators.note: the writing goes round the river, so one is put inside the other

parts.note: prose is ordinary written language
a flower is something that flows, a river; the Po is Italy's longest

explanation.surface: A recommendation is made for an essay on a bloom from Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' means a river (something that flows), not a bloom: here the Po.
explanation.definitionFit: To put forward an idea for consideration is to suggest it.

clue.text: Trunk call in the wind

definitions.meaning: the loud cry an elephant makes through its trunk
a brass instrument blown in an orchestra's wind section

explanation.surface: A long-distance telephone call is made in a gale.
explanation.walkthrough: A trunk call is old British for a long-distance phone call; here it is the elephant's cry.
explanation.definitionFit: An elephant's blast through its trunk is one sense; a valved brass instrument played by blowing is the other.

clue.text: Darlings of modern music makers?

parts.note: terms of endearment, read as the favourite animals kept by chart musicians

explanation.surface: Popular musicians have their favourites.
explanation.definitionFit: Small dear ones, a fond word for children, split as the pets of pop players.

clue.text: Terribly affected over a cut in pay

indicators.note: the small cut goes inside the wages, so one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: taken as written
a nick is a small cut

explanation.surface: Someone is alarmed at a reduction in their wages.
explanation.definitionFit: Gripped by fear and alarm, as someone very upset by bad news is.

clue.text: Said to be a rebuff albeit cunning

indicators.note: spoken out, so the word for a snub is heard rather than written

parts.note: a slight is a snub or rebuff

explanation.surface: Words are spoken as a put-down, though crafty ones.
explanation.definitionFit: Dexterity and craft, as in sleight of hand, the conjuror's trickery.

clue.text: Looping the loop is a danger to road-users

indicators.note: letters thrown into loops are twisted round into a new order

explanation.surface: An aerobatic stunt is hazardous to traffic.
explanation.definitionFit: A hole worn in a road's surface can damage cars and throw cyclists.

clue.text: Main way to describe 22

definitions.meaning: the main is an old word for the open sea, here the largest ocean
an adjective meaning peaceful, the answer at 22

explanation.definitionFit: The great ocean between Asia and the Americas is the 'main'; as an adjective the word means calm and peace-loving.

clue.text: Males indeed upset being corrected

indicators.note: the men are placed inside the word that follows
upset means knocked over and jumbled, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: men are males

explanation.surface: Men are truly upset at being put right.
explanation.walkthrough: The newspaper runs 'in deed' together as 'indeed'; read apart, 'in' is the container signal and 'upset' scrambles the deed, giving EDED around the males.
explanation.definitionFit: A text emended has had its errors removed, as by an editor.

clue.text: Isn't a cardinal point, observe

parts.note: is not, giving the negative word not
E for east, one of the four main compass points

explanation.surface: Something is denied being a main compass direction.
explanation.definitionFit: To notice or take heed of something is to observe it.

clue.text: Step outside Egypt's capital for concord

indicators.note: the step goes outside, so the other letter is placed within it

parts.note: a pace is a single step

indicators.note: a capital letter is the first one of the word Egypt's

explanation.surface: A move is made beyond Egypt's capital for harmony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' means the first letter of Egypt, not Cairo.
explanation.definitionFit: Harmony and absence of war between nations or people.

clue.text: Time to be sorry and adjust

parts.note: to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: It is time to apologise and change one's ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Engineers and carpenters true a wheel or edge, making it exactly straight or level.

clue.text: Highly-strung bird

definitions.meaning: a toy held on a string high in the air

explanation.definitionFit: The paper toy flown on a line and the bird of prey share the name.

clue.text: Source of quiet noise at the fo'c'slehead

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
a row is a din

explanation.surface: Peaceful sounds come from the front of the ship.
explanation.walkthrough: The fo'c'sle (forecastle) is the forward part of a ship; its head is the very front.
explanation.definitionFit: The pointed forward end of a boat's hull is its bow.

clue.text: Such a conveyance seems putting the cart before the horse

definitions.text: Such a conveyance seems putting the cart before the horse

parts.words: Such a conveyance seems putting the cart before the horse
parts.note: read as a horse-drawn vehicle sent ahead of its horse, while the commercial term means the delivery charge is paid by the receiver

explanation.definitionFit: A shipping term: the cost of transport is to be paid on delivery, by the recipient.

clue.text: Handled soft material

explanation.definitionFit: Touched is one sense; the pressed woollen fabric used for hats is the other.

clue.text: He is found among a motley crowd of milk-producers

definitions.text: He is found among a motley crowd of milk-producers

indicators.note: the pronoun sits among the other letters, so it is placed inside them
a motley group is mixed, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A man stands among a mixed herd of dairy cattle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'motley' scrambles the crowd into COWRD. The whole clue pictures the herdsman standing among his dairy cows.
explanation.definitionFit: A man employed to look after cattle at pasture is meant.
